transcript.en: Erm. hello Professor, I'm John Wishart.
transcript.zh: 教授您好，我叫 John Wishart。

transcript.en: I'm working on my entry for the Global Design Competition.
transcript.zh: 我在为参加全球设计大赛做准备。

transcript.en: My tutor said you might be able to help me with it.
transcript.zh: 我的指导老师说您也许能帮帮我。

transcript.en: Ah, yes, I got a copy of your drawings.
transcript.zh: 啊，对，我这儿有你的画的复印件。

transcript.en: Come in and tell me about it.
transcript.zh: 快进来跟我说说。

transcript.en: What sort of competition is it?
transcript.zh: 对了，你参加的是个什么比赛来着？

transcript.en: Well, it's an international design competition and we have to come up with a new design for a typical domestic kitchen appliance.
transcript.zh: 它是一个国际性的设计比赛，我们需要为一种典型的家庭厨房用具想出一个全新的设计。

transcript.en: I see, and are there any special conditions? Does it have to save energy for example?
transcript.zh: 我知道了，还有什么特殊要求吗？比如要节能什么的？

transcript.en: Actually that was the focus in last year's competition.
transcript.zh: 实际上那是去年比赛的重点。

transcript.en: This year's different. We have to adopt an innovative approach to existing technology, using it in a way that hasn't been thought of before.
transcript.zh: 今年的不一样。我们要采用一种创新的方法来使用现有技术，要以一种别人之前都没想到过的方法使用它。

transcript.en: I see, that sounds tricky.
transcript.zh: 这样啊，听起来挺棘手的。

transcript.en: And what kitchen appliance have you chosen?
transcript.zh: 你选了什么厨房用具？

transcript.en: Well, I decided to choose the dishwasher.
transcript.zh: 我选择了洗碗机。

transcript.en: Interesting, what made you choose that?
transcript.zh: 有意思，你为什么会选这个呢？

transcript.en: Well, they're an everyday kitchen appliance in most Australian houses but they're all pretty boring and almost identical to each other.
transcript.zh: 首先，它们是大部分澳大利亚家庭每天都要用的厨房用具，然后这些洗碗机的外形都很单调，基本上没什么区别。

transcript.en: I think some people will be prepared to pay a little extra for something that looks different.
transcript.zh: 我想会有人愿意稍微多付一点钱来购买外形独特一些的产品的。

transcript.en: That's a nice idea.
transcript.zh: 想法不错。

transcript.en: I see you've called your design 'the Rockpool'; why is that?
transcript.zh: 我看见你把你的设计取名叫做“ the Rockpool”, 怎么会想到这个名字呢？

transcript.en: Basically because it looks like the rock pools you find on a beach.
transcript.zh: 主要是因为它看起来就像海滩上的潮水潭一样。

transcript.en: The top is made of glass so that you can look down into it.
transcript.zh: 它的顶端是玻璃做的，所以可以低头往里面看。

transcript.en: And there's a stone at the bottom.
transcript.zh: 底部还有一块石头，

transcript.en: Is that just for decoration?
transcript.zh: 那只是个装饰吗？

transcript.en: Actually it does have a function.
transcript.zh: 实际上它是有作用的。

transcript.en: Instead of pushing a button, you turn the stone.
transcript.zh: 这款洗碗机不需要按按钮，只要转一下这块石头就可以了。

transcript.en: So it's really just a novel way of starting the dishwasher.
transcript.zh: 那这确实是一种启动洗碗机的新奇方法。

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: It's a really nice design, but what makes it innovative?
transcript.zh: 这个设计真的很棒，不过它创新在哪里呢？

transcript.en: Well, I decided to make a dishwasher that uses carbon dioxide.
transcript.zh: 我决定把这台洗碗机设计成使用二氧化碳来洗碗。

transcript.en: In place of water and detergent?
transcript.zh: 用来代替水和清洁剂？

transcript.en: How will you manage that?
transcript.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

transcript.en: The idea is to pressurise the carbon dioxide so that it becomes a liquid.
transcript.zh: 原理是把二氧化碳加压至液体状态，

transcript.en: The fluid is then released into the dishwasher where it cleans the dishes all by itself.
transcript.zh: 然后这个液体就会流入洗碗机中独自完成洗碗的工作。

transcript.en: Sounds like a brilliant idea! Your system will totally do away with the need for strong detergents.
transcript.zh: 你这个想法听起来真是太妙了！有了你的这套系统，我们就再也不需要强力清洁剂了。

transcript.en: So what happens once the dishes are clean?
transcript.zh: 那这些碗碟洗干净之后怎么办？

transcript.en: Well, to allow them to dry, the liquid carbon dioxide and the waste materials all go to an area called the holding chamber.
transcript.zh: 为了把这些碗碟弄干，液体二氧化碳和那些废料都会进入一个叫做“保存室”的地方。

transcript.en: That's where the liquid is depressurised and so it reverts to a gas.
transcript.zh: 在那里，液体二氧化碳会被减压，然后变成气体。

transcript.en: Then the oil and grease are separated out and sent to the waste system.
transcript.zh: 而那些油脂会被分离出来送到废物系统中去。

transcript.en: It sounds like you've thought it all out very thoroughly.
transcript.zh: 看起来你似乎把各个方面都考虑到了，很全面嘛。

transcript.en: So, what happens to the carbon dioxide once the process is complete?
transcript.zh: 那这个过程结束之后二氧化碳要怎么处理呢？

transcript.en: Not wasted I hope.
transcript.zh: 不会就那么浪费了吧？

transcript.en: Actually, that's where the real savings are made.
transcript.zh: 事实上，这才是真正节能的地方。

transcript.en: The carbon dioxide is sent back to the cylinder and can be used again and again.
transcript.zh: 二氧化碳会被送回气缸中，可以一直循环使用。

transcript.en: What a terrific idea.
transcript.zh: 你这个想法太好了。

transcript.en: Do you think it will ever be built?
transcript.zh: 你觉得这种洗碗机真的能被制造出来吗？

transcript.en: Probably not, but that's OK.
transcript.zh: 可能制造不出来吧，不过也没关系。

transcript.en: Well, I'm sure a lot of positive things will come out of your design.
transcript.zh: 我相信从你的设计中会产生很多积极的东西的。

transcript.en: Now, you seem to have thought about everything so what exactly did you need me to help you with?
transcript.zh: 你似乎把所有的事情都考虑到了，那你具体需要我帮助你什么呢？

transcript.en: Well, my design has made it to the final stage of the competition and, in a few months' time. I have to give a presentation, and that's the part I was hoping you could help me with.
transcript.zh: 我的设计已经进入决赛了，再过几个月的时间我就要做一个陈述，而这就是我希望您能帮我的地方。

transcript.en: Right, well that should be easy enough.
transcript.zh: 好吧，这应该蛮简单的。

transcript.en: What have you managed to do so far?
transcript.zh: 你到目前为止都准备了什么？

transcript.en: Well, I've got detailed drawings to show how it will work and I've also written a 500-word paper on it.
transcript.zh: 我画了一幅很具体的图来展示洗碗机的具体原理，还写了一篇500字的文章。

transcript.en: I see.
transcript.zh: 我知道了。

transcript.en: Well, if you want to stand a good chance of winning you really need a model of the machine.
transcript.zh: 如果你想稳操胜券的话，真的还是要准备一个机器的模型。

transcript.en: Yes, I thought I might but I'm having a few problems.
transcript.zh: 对，我想过可能需要这么做，但是我遇到了一些麻烦。

transcript.en: What is the main difficulty so far?
transcript.zh: 目前你最主要的困难是什么？

transcript.en: Let me guess - is it the materials?
transcript.zh: 让我猜一下，是不是材料问题？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: I want it to look professional but everything that's top quality is also very expensive.
transcript.zh: 我想让它看起来专业一些，但是所有的优质材料都很贵。

transcript.en: Look, projects like this are very important to us. They really help lift our profile.
transcript.zh: 你看，像这样的项目对我们来说非常重要，它们真的能帮我们把个人简介提升一个档次。

transcript.en: So why don't you talk to the university about a grant?
transcript.zh: 所以你为什么不跟学校申请一笔补助呢？

transcript.en: I can help you fill out the application forms if you like.
transcript.zh: 你要是想的话，我可以帮你填一下表格

transcript.en: That would be great.
transcript.zh: 那太好了

transcript.en: You'd better show me this paper you've written as well.
transcript.zh: 你最好把你写的那篇文章也给我看看。

transcript.en: For a global competition such as this you need to make sure the technical details you've given are accurate and thorough.
transcript.zh: 像这样的全球性比赛，你得确保给出的所有技术性细节都是精确全面的。

transcript.en: That would be a great help.
transcript.zh: 您真是帮了我一个大忙。

transcript.en: Is there anything else I can do?
transcript.zh: 还有别的事情需要我帮忙吗？
